rows.text: loads qword `+0x10F78` of qword `0209BE80` into `rcx` and tail-jumps (`0028F810` + 0xE) with every other argument register passed through unchanged

returns without a write when `rcx` is null or when the whole of `edx` equals bit 5 of dword `rcx+0xC8`; otherwise replaces bit 5 of that dword with bit 0 of `edx` and walks the two qwords at `+0xC8` and `+0xD0` of qword `+0xC0` of qword `02B62D88`, calling `00406DD0` + 0x7B with the entry in `rcx` and the incoming `edx` for each entry that is non-null and has bit 4 (0x10) of byte `+0x130` set, skipping it when qword `02B62D88`, its `+0xC0` qword or the entry is null or that bit is clear

notes: 00406DD0: the bit-5 compare is against the full 32-bit edx (cmp esi, eax), so an edx other than 0 or 1 always takes the write path and stores bit 0 of edx. The loop has two bounds (rbx from 0xC8 below 0xD8 step 8, and rdi below 2); both give two passes. When qword 02B62D88 was null on a pass the register is not re-read until after a call, so a null global skips both entries. The other host call site 004052B0 + 0xC is equally valid as entered_from. 0028F810: the tail-jump callee is not named in the host excerpt, so it is cited by site.
